packs.description: Domain-neutral business planning vocabulary and controls.
planning_facts: Domain knowledge may enrich planning but cannot authorize execution.

packs.description: Provider-neutral network engineering and operations planning knowledge.
planning_facts: Network changes require bounded scope, observability, change controls, and rollback readiness.

packs.description: Provider-neutral network automation pilot planning knowledge.
planning_facts: A controlled network automation pilot separates management approval from delegated technical execution.
Cloud infrastructure plans should identify environment scope, availability controls, and recovery evidence.

packs.description: Security and compliance planning knowledge without external execution authority.
planning_facts: Compliance readiness requires authoritative scope, mapped controls, and traceable evidence.
People decisions require explicit ownership, appropriate privacy, and evidence-based review.
Financial plans should distinguish confirmed amounts, estimates, constraints, and approval authority.
